sloka: तमहं बलसम्पन्नं राक्षसं रणकोविदम् ।परिघेणातिघोरेण सूदयामि सहानुगम् ।। ५.५८.११८ ।।५.५८.११७ ।।।।
transliteration: tamahaṁ balasampannaṁ rākṣasaṁ raṇakovidam ।parigheṇātighoreṇa sūdayāmi sahānugam ।। 5.58.118 ।।5.58.117 ।।।।

translations.english: "With a dreadful iron bar I slayed Jambumali, who was endowed with mighty strength, and was an expert in war and other terrific ogres who accompanied him.
